CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2626 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 6bee9961fa8bbb90d50392fee75a64ab88a3d8e2. Bus nonce: 53a94b8780c68537c4f9f363080130b1. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 6bee9961fa8bbb90d50392fee75a64ab88a3d8e2`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 6bee9961fa8bbb90d50392fee75a64ab88a3d8e2` or `Fix review: blocked 6bee9961fa8bbb90d50392fee75a64ab88a3d8e2 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 53a94b8780c68537c4f9f363080130b1`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `6bee9961fa8bbb90d50392fee75a64ab88a3d8e2` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2626 6bee9961fa8bbb90d50392fee75a64ab88a3d8e2") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2626-53a94b87`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Fix reviewer for PR #2626 (tvofi/heatpump_optimizer), group R10-ROSTER-OPS, roster batch 15. Read the group entry with `git show origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster:dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json` (jq/python the group whose "group" is R10-ROSTER-OPS). Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md exactly, from a detached worktree at the head SHA 6bee9961fa8bbb90d50392fee75a64ab88a3d8e2.

This is a roster diff: check it mechanically against the batch list in the PR body (every group, stage and carry named there must match the diff; a figure in the body that describes another diff is blocking). Use the finder harness the group brief names, never the fixer harness. A red nightly-status grades main and is not this PR unless its diff reaches what that check reads.
Your ev/ MUST contain a file holding the full 40-hex head sha (ev/HEAD.txt), or the relay refuses the verdict.

Do not add Claude Code footers, Co-Authored-By/Claude-Session trailers or any claude.ai session link to commits, verdicts or comments.
